description: WP-C7 Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) REPULSOR SUSPENSOR TECHNOLOGY (Coronus Grav-carrier, once per phase) through the real enemy_has_shot window. Fixture cus11e_c7_enemy_shoot (P1 Orks' Shooting phase vs P2 Custodes). A real token click selects the Tankbustas; their Busta rokkit launchas (Hunter) are declared at the Coronus with the phase actions the shooting panel sends and resolved by real clicks on Fast Roll / Complete Shooting. The Coronus lost wounds: P2's enemy_has_shot window offers the card (cost 'Ability'); a real click rolls the D6 and opens the normal-move panel; a real drag moves the Coronus 1" and a real click on Confirm move finishes it; the once-per-phase use is recorded. Setup privileges: auto wound allocation; both players have 0 CP (no paid stratagem competes; abilities cost none); the Coronus' wounds inflated.

steps.script:
SettingsService.set("auto_allocate_wounds", true)
GameState.state.players["1"]["cp"] = 0
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
for m in GameState.state.units["U_CORONUS_A"].models:
	m["wounds"] = 99
	m["current_wounds"] = 99
return true
